svg.title: Illustration of the read-only dashboard
svg.desc: An illustration, redrawn in greys with invented example data, of the dashboard that tools/projection.py renders from a project's files as one read-only page, in a narrow layout. At the top, the pack and the project in use, then the project's derived state, WAITING_ON_IDENTIFIED_JOB, and the next authorised action. Then the situation: a running job with its deadline, a pending human approval, an audit whose subject is the current candidate, and capacity. Below, part of what needs attention: warnings, and a reading that could not be established, shown as unknown. At the bottom, budgets and evidence.
